name: Devon Four
description: Devon Four was a planet aligned with the Galactic Republic. Several years before the Clone Wars broke out, the government of the planet—members of a religious sect—refused to pay taxes. The planet was subsequently embargoed by the Republic, which even prevented medicine being delivered to the planet during an outbreak of plague. Smugglers organized by Sheeka Tull later broke the embargo.
